title: Conrack
writer: Pat Conroy, Irving Ravetch, Harriet Frank Jr.
actors: Jon Voight, Paul Winfield, Madge Sinclair
plot: The true story of Pat Conroy, a handsome, idealistic Caucasian who is an elementary-school instructor for a group of poor Black children in an isolated school.
